name: error-boundary
title: Error boundary
description: A React error boundary with a calm built-in fallback, a reset that really remounts the subtree, resetKeys, and a hook for your error logger.
docs: Wrap any subtree: when a child throws while rendering, the fallback replaces it and the rest of the page keeps working. fallback is a node or a function that gets { error, reset } (a function needs a Client Component parent); onError is the place for your logger; resetKeys resets the boundary when a route, an id or a filter changes; reset mounts the children anew. withErrorBoundary lives in error-boundary/with-error-boundary and is not a client module. Event handlers, async code and the server are outside what a boundary catches: use error.tsx for the page.
